lines.text: Jesus says He is going to the One who sent Him, and that if He goes, He will send the Advocate.
Jesus says the Advocate will convict the world in regard to sin, righteousness and judgment.
Jesus says the Spirit of truth will guide the disciples into all truth and will speak on His own.
Jesus says the disciples will grieve, but their grief will turn to joy, like a woman who forgets her anguish after childbirth.
Jesus says the disciples will be scattered and leave Him all alone, yet He is not alone because the angels are with Him.
